items.title: For decades Australian house prices have grown. This is what a fall could mean
items.description: After decades of growth Australian house prices are slowing. Here's what a fall could look like.

items.title: Widow warns of shock ambulance bill after husband's unexpected death
items.description: Private health insurers can legally avoid ambulance bills because corpses are not considered patients, a loophole that left a grieving widow shocked.

items.title: Live: Minister defends calling former PM Menzies a 'Nazi appeaser'
items.description: Defence Industry Minister Pat Conroy has doubled down on calling former prime minister Robert Menzies a "Nazi appeaser" at the National Press Club. Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: Suspected bird flu case detected in NSW
items.description: A suspected positive case of H5 bird flu has been identified in New South Wales, the state agriculture minister has announced.

items.title: Breaking: Firefighters' union loses Supreme Court bid to keep corruption probe secret
items.description: An investigation into allegations of corruption during the tenure of former Victorian premier Daniel Andrews was finished in 2022, but its release has been delayed by court action.

items.title: Man who spent eight days stuck under collapsed shopping centre in Venezuela rescued alive
items.description: Hernan Alberto Gil Flores, a 43-year-old Venezuelan man was dug out alive from under the ruins of a collapsed shopping centre, eight days after devastating earthquakes shook the nation.

items.title: Moira Deeming launches legal action as party meeting on her future looms
items.description: Mrs Deeming has lodged a case against Victorian Liberal Party president Brian Loughnane in the Supreme Court.

items.title: Secret police recordings of croc wrangler Matt Wright released
items.description: Secretly recorded phone calls and conversations crucial to the criminal case against celebrity crocodile wrangler Matt Wright during his Northern Territory Supreme Court trial have been released to the media.

items.title: Live: Ronaldo, VAR and snicko rescue Portugal in thriller against Croatia
items.description: Portugal comes from behind, Cristiano Ronaldo scores and Croatia is denied a late equaliser by VAR, while Spain turns on the style to beat Austria 3-0. Follow live.

items.title: UK uncovers international network of men drugging and assaulting women
items.description: In echoes of the high-profile Gisele Pelicot case, the National Crime Agency says it has identified more than 270 individuals linked to an online forum and its offshoots.

items.title: 'Advocate for yourself': Woman's warning after partner's cancer death
items.description: Rory Esler's family and friends will take part in the Gold Coast marathon festival this weekend to honour his memory and to raise awareness, encouraging young Australians to advocate for themselves when navigating the medical system.

items.title: Worst start to ski season since 1957, as blizzard finally dumps snow
items.description: Following the worst start to a ski season in decades, a major snowstorm hit the NSW and Victorian Alps last night.

items.title: Ohio town in shock after 16 kids found in squalor 'right under our noses'
items.description: Just days after authorities removed 16 children from a squalid home and arrested four adult relatives, the question looms over their southern Ohio village: how could this have happened, for years, unnoticed.

items.title: Papua rebels shoot dead American pilot in 'message' to US and Indonesia
items.description: A Papua separatist group says it shot dead an American pilot who allegedly transported Indonesian troops into the restive province.

items.title: If the odds are anything to go by, this 104yo WWII veteran should not be alive
items.description: Eighty five years ago, Brian Walley, a prisoner of war in a German camp after crashing his bomber into the North Sea, doubted he would live for long. Yesterday, he celebrated his 104th birthday.

items.title: How the soundtracks for Arcane and League of Legends are made
items.description: Musicians and game developers work closely to make the world of League of Legends sound so incredible.

items.title: Friday news quiz: A space rescue, high-profile pranks and the importance of using your full posterior
items.description: It's all fun and games in the ABC news quiz until someone loses a telescope.

items.title: Can the Socceroos beat Egypt?
items.description: Can the Socceroos beat Egypt and win their first ever knockout final at a World Cup?  The Pharaohs have Salah, Marmoush and a dangerous counterattack, but the Socceroos have the physical edge, aerial threats and set-piece power to cause serious problems. We take a closer look Egypt's strengths, and why Australia are a dangerous underdog that shouldn't be written off.

items.title: MP calls for investigation into anti-abortion campaigner
items.description: Anti-abortion campaigner Joanna Howe has been called out for potentially breaching campaign financing laws, with one MP labelling her "attack" style as harmful and dangerous.

items.title: $184m budget push 'does not touch the sides' of demand, DV body says
items.description: A recent $184.1 million state budget investment is not enough of a "breakthrough" for critically outstretched domestic violence services, says Delia Donovan.

items.title: Why would Taylor Swift get married at Madison Square Garden?
items.description: Fans believe they know the when and where of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's upcoming nuptials, but much of the reported two-day extravaganza will likely be a cloak-and-dagger operation.

items.title: Live: ASX on the up, TPG retains Thickins
items.description: The ASX has opened higher after weaker US jobs data eased interest rate hike expectations. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Cheap oil 'can only last so long' unless Strait of Hormuz fully reopens
items.description: Ampol's chief executive says the Iran conflict exposed Australia's fuel vulnerability and strengthened the case for keeping its remaining refinery operating.

items.title: Victims 'thrown into uncertainty' by Christian Brothers court ruling
items.description: Lawyers argue the court's decision to grant a moratorium had thrown abuse survivors into uncertainty.

items.title: Teenager charged with murder after death in Melbourne's north
items.description: A 16-year-old boy has been charged with murder after a boy was found with stab wounds outside a Craigieburn hospital.
